title: AILIS: A Proposed Layer Model for AI Systems
description: AILIS (AI Layer Interface Specification) is an OSI-inspired proposal for discussing AI systems in shared, layered terms. It defines a common architecture language for the AI stack — layers, interfaces, and case studies — so that builders, researchers, and operators can locate capabilities, boundaries, and interoperability points consistently across systems.
